verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration firm, so dependent visas for a spouse and children are a fair question. The evidence covers O-1, H-1B, NIW I-140 and employer compliance work but never documents O-3 or H-4 dependent filings or spouse work authorization as part of the service. The llms.txt line that Ellis Porter helps 'families move forward' is too generic to count as documented dependent-visa support.

support.subject: As a founder, dependent visas for my spouse and children (O-3, H-4, and work authorization where it exists) are documented as part of the service
